title: With Russia's strikes in Ukraine and hybrid war in Europe, Kyiv's allies face heightened uncertainty
subhead: Russia has stepped up deep strikes in Ukraine and continued its hybrid warfare against Europe, just as US support is faltering. Washington is warning of a possible Russian attack to test Western defenses.

subhead: The EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation, which comes into effect on Wednesday, August 12, introduces binding reduction targets for the first time in Europe, though it has been undermined by heavy industry lobbying.

title: Germany: 'Friedrich Merz's political solitude raises doubts over his lasting ability to persuade'
subhead: The German chancellor, who finds himself increasingly isolated, even within his own party, repeatedly makes missteps and fails to set a clear political course for Germany, laments Franco-German author Nils Minkmar in this opinion piece.

title: 'I can't stand being only breasts. The eyes burn me': Breasts, a tale of men, women and the times
subhead: 'My Breasts and Me' (4/5). Once a symbol of objectifying women, plastic surgery now draws more women practitioners. The #MeToo wave shook up society and patients' expectations have evolved, reshaping boundaries between genders. Le Monde spent weeks behind closed doors in a private breast surgery practice.

title: 'It was either exile or prison': An interview with Boris Nadezhdin, Putin opponent who fled to France
subhead: The veteran Russian politician, 63, tried to challenge Vladimir Putin's regime and its war in Ukraine through legal and electoral means. He failed. Facing the threat of arrest, he decided to leave Russia. His interview with Le Monde is his first since arriving in France.

title: Trump's secret exfiltration betrays nerves and improvisation over his security
subhead: Following the NATO summit on July 8 in Ankara, journalists believed they were traveling with the US president aboard the former Air Force One plane. In reality, the president had been discreetly transferred to another aircraft due to threats from Iran, the 'Washington Post' and 'New York Times' revealed.
